{"content": "     1|/**
     2| * 中国象棋走法与将军判定（标准棋规：马蹩腿、象塞眼、炮隔山、将帅不见面）。
     3| * 坐标：10 行 × 9 列，row 0 为黑方底线，row 9 为红方底线；黑子为负、红子为正。
     4| */
     5|
     6|export const ROWS = 10
     7|export const COLS = 9
     8|
     9|export const P = {
    10|  GENERAL: 1,
    11|  ADVISOR: 2,
    12|  ELEPHANT: 3,
    13|  HORSE: 4,
    14|  CHARIOT: 5,
    15|  CANNON: 6,
    16|  SOLDIER: 7,
    17|}
    18|
    19|const abs = Math.abs
    20|
    21|function side(p) {
    22|  if (p > 0) return 1
    23|  if (p < 0) return -1
    24|  return 0
    25|}
    26|
    27|/** 将/帅是否在九宫内 */
    28|function inPalace(r, c, red) {
    29|  if (c < 3 || c > 5) return false
    30|  if (red) return r >= 7 && r <= 9
    31|  return r >= 0 && r <= 2
    32|}
    33|
    34|function isRed(p) {
    35|  return p > 0
    36|}
    37|
    38|/** 兵是否已过河 */
    39|function soldierCrossedRiver(r, red) {
    40|  if (red) return r <= 4
    41|  return r >= 5
    42|}
    43|
    44|export function createInitialBoard() {
    45|  const b = Array.from({ length: ROWS }, () => new Array(COLS).fill(0))
    46|  const backRow = [
    47|    P.CHARIOT,
    48|    P.HORSE,
    49|    P.ELEPHANT,
    50|    P.ADVISOR,
    51|    P.GENERAL,
    52|    P.ADVISOR,
    53|    P.ELEPHANT,
    54|    P.HORSE,
    55|    P.CHARIOT,
    56|  ]
    57|  backRow.forEach((p, c) => {
    58|    b[9][c] = p
    59|  })
    60|  b[7][1] = P.CANNON
    61|  b[7][7] = P.CANNON
    62|  for (let c = 0; c < 9; c += 2) b[6][c] = P.SOLDIER
    63|
    64|  backRow.forEach((p, c) => {
    65|    b[0][c] = -p
    66|  })
    67|  b[2][1] = -P.CANNON
    68|  b[2][7] = -P.CANNON
    69|  for (let c = 0; c < 9; c += 2) b[3][c] = -P.SOLDIER
    70|  return b
    71|}
    72|
    73|/** 将帅是否照面（同一列上无子相隔） */
    74|export function generalsFace(board, sr, sc, tr, tc) {
    75|  const tb = board.map((row) => [...row])
    76|  const p = tb[sr][sc]
    77|  tb[sr][sc] = 0
    78|  tb[tr][tc] = p
    79|
    80|  let gr = -1
    81|  let gc = -1
    82|  let br = -1
    83|  let bc = -1
    84|  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    85|    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
    86|      if (tb[r][c] === P.GENERAL) {
    87|        gr = r
    88|        gc = c
    89|      }
    90|      if (tb[r][c] === -P.GENERAL) {
    91|        br = r
    92|        bc = c
    93|      }
    94|    }
    95|  }
    96|  if (gr < 0 || br < 0) return false
    97|  if (gc !== bc) return false
    98|  const lo = Math.min(gr, br)
    99|  const hi = Math.max(gr, br)
   100|  for (let r = lo + 1; r < hi; r++) {
   101|    if (tb[r][gc] !== 0) return false
   102|  }
   103|  return true
   104|}
   105|
   106|function addRookSteps(board, r, c, piece, out, captureOnly = false) {
   107|  const dirs = [
   108|    [1, 0],
   109|    [-1, 0],
   110|    [0, 1],
   111|    [0, -1],
   112|  ]
   113|  for (const [dr, dc] of dirs) {
   114|    for (let i = 1; i < 16; i++) {
   115|      const nr = r + dr * i
   116|      const nc = c + dc * i
   117|      if (nr < 0 || nr >= ROWS || nc < 0 || nc >= COLS) break
   118|      const t = board[nr][nc]
   119|      if (t === 0) {
   120|        if (!captureOnly) out.push([nr, nc])
   121|      } else {
   122|        if (side(t) !== side(piece)) out.push([nr, nc])
   123|        break
   124|      }
   125|    }
   126|  }
   127|}
   128|
   129|function addCannonMoves(board, r, c, piece, out) {
   130|  const dirs = [
   131|    [1, 0],
   132|    [-1, 0],
   133|    [0, 1],
   134|    [0, -1],
   135|  ]
   136|  for (const [dr, dc] of dirs) {
   137|    let i = 1
   138|    while (true) {
   139|      const nr = r + dr * i
   140|      const nc = c + dc * i
   141|      if (nr < 0 || nr >= ROWS || nc < 0 || nc >= COLS) break
   142|      if (board[nr][nc] === 0) out.push([nr, nc])
   143|      else {
   144|        let j = i + 1
   145|        while (true) {
   146|          const nr2 = r + dr * j
   147|          const nc2 = c + dc * j
   148|          if (nr2 < 0 || nr2 >= ROWS || nc2 < 0 || nc2 >= COLS) break
   149|          const t2 = board[nr2][nc2]
   150|          if (t2 === 0) {
   151|            j++
   152|            continue
   153|          }
   154|          if (side(t2) !== side(piece)) out.push([nr2, nc2])
   155|          break
   156|        }
   157|        break
   158|      }
   159|      i++
   160|    }
   161|  }
   162|}
   163|
   164|/** 马八向：绊马腿占用格 */
   165|const KNIGHT_DELTAS = [
   166|  { dr: 2, dc: 1, br: 1, bc: 0 },
   167|  { dr: 2, dc: -1, br: 1, bc: 0 },
   168|  { dr: -2, dc: 1, br: -1, bc: 0 },
   169|  { dr: -2, dc: -1, br: -1, bc: 0 },
   170|  { dr: 1, dc: 2, br: 0, bc: 1 },
   171|  { dr: 1, dc: -2, br: 0, bc: -1 },
   172|  { dr: -1, dc: 2, br: 0, bc: 1 },
   173|  { dr: -1, dc: -2, br: 0, bc: -1 },
   174|]
   175|
   176|function addHorseMoves(board, r, c, piece, out) {
   177|  for (const { dr, dc, br, bc } of KNIGHT_DELTAS) {
   178|    const lr = r + br
   179|    const lc = c + bc
   180|    if (lr < 0 || lr >= ROWS || lc < 0 || lc >= COLS || board[lr][lc] !== 0) continue
   181|    const nr = r + dr
   182|    const nc = c + dc
   183|    if (nr < 0 || nr >= ROWS || nc < 0 || nc >= COLS) continue
   184|    const t = board[nr][nc]
   185|    if (t === 0 || side(t) !== side(piece)) out.push([nr, nc])
   186|  }
   187|}
   188|
   189|const ELEPHANT_DELTAS = [
   190|  { dr: 2, dc: 2, er: 1, ec: 1 },
   191|  { dr: 2, dc: -2, er: 1, ec: -1 },
   192|  { dr: -2, dc: 2, er: -1, ec: 1 },
   193|  { dr: -2, dc: -2, er: -1, ec: -1 },
   194|]
   195|
   196|function addElephantMoves(board, r, c, piece, out) {
   197|  const red = isRed(piece)
   198|  for (const { dr, dc, er, ec } of ELEPHANT_DELTAS) {
   199|    const erf = r + er
   200|    const ecf = c + ec
   201|    if (erf < 0 || erf >= ROWS || ecf < 0 || ecf >= COLS || board[erf][ecf] !== 0) continue
   202|    const nr = r + dr
   203|    const nc = c + dc
   204|    if (nr < 0 || nr >= ROWS || nc < 0 || nc >= COLS) continue
   205|    if (red) {
   206|      if (nr < 5) continue
   207|    } else {
   208|      if (nr > 4) continue
   209|    }
   210|    const t = board[nr][nc]
   211|    if (t === 0 || side(t) !== side(piece)) out.push([nr, nc])
   212|  }
   213|}
   214|
   215|function addAdvisorMoves(board, r, c, piece, out) {
   216|  const red = isRed(piece)
   217|  const steps = [
   218|    [1, 1],
   219|    [1, -1],
   220|    [-1, 1],
   221|    [-1, -1],
   222|  ]
   223|  for (const [dr, dc] of steps) {
   224|    const nr = r + dr
   225|    const nc = c + dc
   226|    if (!inPalace(nr, nc, red)) continue
   227|    const t = board[nr][nc]
   228|    if (t === 0 || side(t) !== side(piece)) out.push([nr, nc])
   229|  }
   230|}
   231|
   232|function addGeneralMoves(board, r, c, piece, out) {
   233|  const red = isRed(piece)
   234|  const orth = [
   235|    [1, 0],
   236|    [-1, 0],
   237|    [0, 1],
   238|    [0, -1],
   239|  ]
   240|  for (const [dr, dc] of orth) {
   241|    const nr = r + dr
   242|    const nc = c + dc
   243|    if (!inPalace(nr, nc, red)) continue
   244|    const t = board[nr][nc]
   245|    if (t === 0 || side(t) !== side(piece)) out.push([nr, nc])
   246|  }
   247|}
   248|
   249|function addSoldierMoves(board, r, c, piece, out) {
   250|  const red = isRed(piece)
   251|  const forward = red ? -1 : 1
   252|  const nr = r + forward
   253|  if (nr >= 0 && nr < ROWS) {
   254|    const t = board[nr][c]
   255|    if (t === 0 || side(t) !== side(piece)) out.push([nr, c])
   256|  }
   257|  if (soldierCrossedRiver(r, red)) {
   258|    for (const dc of [-1, 1]) {
   259|      const nc = c + dc
   260|      if (nc < 0 || nc >= COLS) continue
   261|      const t = board[r][nc]
   262|      if (t === 0 || side(t) !== side(piece)) out.push([r, nc])
   263|    }
   264|  }
   265|}
   266|
   267|/** 某格上棋子的所有伪合法落点（未滤将、将帅照面） */
   268|export function getPseudoLegalMoves(board, r, c) {
   269|  const piece = board[r][c]
   270|  if (piece === 0) return []
   271|  const tp = abs(piece)
   272|  const out = []
   273|  switch (tp) {
   274|    case P.GENERAL:
   275|      addGeneralMoves(board, r, c, piece, out)
   276|      break
   277|    case P.ADVISOR:
   278|      addAdvisorMoves(board, r, c, piece, out)
   279|      break
   280|    case P.ELEPHANT:
   281|      addElephantMoves(board, r, c, piece, out)
   282|      break
   283|    case P.HORSE:
   284|      addHorseMoves(board, r, c, piece, out)
   285|      break
   286|    case P.CHARIOT:
   287|      addRookSteps(board, r, c, piece, out, false)
   288|      break
   289|    case P.CANNON:
   290|      addCannonMoves(board, r, c, piece, out)
   291|      break
   292|    case P.SOLDIER:
   293|      addSoldierMoves(board, r, c, piece, out)
   294|      break
   295|    default:
   296|      break
   297|  }
   298|  return out
   299|}
   300|
   301|export function applyMove(board, fr, fc, tr, tc) {
   302|  const next = board.map((row) => [...row])
   303|  next[tr][tc] = next[fr][fc]
   304|  next[fr][fc] = 0
   305|  return next
   306|}
   307|
   308|export function findGeneral(board, playerSide) {
   309|  const target = playerSide > 0 ? P.GENERAL : -P.GENERAL
   310|  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   311|    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   312|      if (board[r][c] === target) return [r, c]
   313|    }
   314|  }
   315|  return null
   316|}
   317|
   318|/** 某方老将是否被「将军」 */
   319|export function isInCheck(board, friendlySide) {
   320|  const gen = findGeneral(board, friendlySide)
   321|  if (!gen) return false
   322|  const [gr, gc] = gen
   323|  const opp = -friendlySide
   324|  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   325|    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   326|      if (side(board[r][c]) !== opp) continue
   327|      const moves = getPseudoLegalMoves(board, r, c)
   328|      for (const [tr, tc] of moves) {
   329|        if (tr === gr && tc === gc) return true
   330|      }
   331|    }
   332|  }
   333|  return false
   334|}
   335|
   336|/** 含「不等于送将」「不走成将帅照面」的合法着法 */
   337|export function getValidMoves(board, r, c) {
   338|  const piece = board[r][c]
   339|  if (piece === 0) return []
   340|  const side_ = side(piece)
   341|  const pseudo = getPseudoLegalMoves(board, r, c)
   342|  const legal = []
   343|  for (const [tr, tc] of pseudo) {
   344|    if (generalsFace(board, r, c, tr, tc)) continue
   345|    const next = applyMove(board, r, c, tr, tc)
   346|    if (!isInCheck(next, side_)) legal.push([tr, tc])
   347|  }
   348|  return legal
   349|}
   350|
   351|/**
   352| * 当前行棋方是否被将死（无合法着法）。
   353| * @param {number} sideToMove 1 红先或轮到红，-1 黑
   354| */
   355|export function isCheckmate(board, sideToMove) {
   356|  if (!isInCheck(board, sideToMove)) return false
   357|  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   358|    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   359|      if (side(board[r][c]) !== sideToMove) continue
   360|      if (getValidMoves(board, r, c).length > 0) return false
   361|    }
   362|  }
   363|  return true
   364|}
   365|
   366|export function isStalemate(board, sideToMove) {
   367|  if (isInCheck(board, sideToMove)) return false
   368|  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   369|    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   370|      if (side(board[r][c]) !== sideToMove) continue
   371|      if (getValidMoves(board, r, c).length > 0) return false
   372|    }
   373|  }
   374|  return true
   375|}
   376|
   377|// ── AI 评估系统 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   378|
   379|/**
   380| * 棋子基础分值（厘兵 centipawn，兵=100）。
   381| * 将帅取极大值用于将死检测；其余参考象棋棋子价值惯例。
   382| */
   383|const PIECE_BASE_VALUE = {
   384|  [P.GENERAL]:  100000,
   385|  [P.CHARIOT]:    900,
   386|  [P.CANNON]:     450,
   387|  [P.HORSE]:      400,
   388|  [P.ADVISOR]:    200,
   389|  [P.ELEPHANT]:   200,
   390|  [P.SOLDIER]:    100,
   391|}
   392|
   393|/**
   394| * 棋子位置奖励。
   395| * pieceSide: 1=红, -1=黑。fwd 为前进方向上的距离（0=本阵底，9=对方阵底）。
   396| */
   397|function positionalBonus(type, r, c, pieceSide) {
   398|  const fwd = pieceSide === 1 ? 9 - r : r  // 0=本阵, 9=对方底
   399|
   400|  switch (type) {
   401|    case P.CHARIOT: {
   402|      // 偏好中路纵线 + 适度前插
   403|      const center = c >= 3 && c <= 5 ? 15 : 0
   404|      return center + Math.min(fwd * 2, 20)
   405|    }
   406|    case P.CANNON: {
   407|      // 偏好中部横列、中路纵线（炮台）
   408|      const center = c >= 2 && c <= 6 ? 15 : 0
   409|      const rank = fwd >= 2 && fwd <= 6 ? 10 : 0
   410|      return center + rank
   411|    }
   412|    case P.HORSE: {
   413|      // 强偏好中腹，边角重惩
   414|      const distR = abs(r - 4.5)
   415|      const distC = abs(c - 4)
   416|      return Math.max(-30, 30 - (distR + distC) * 8)
   417|    }
   418|    case P.SOLDIER: {
   419|      // 过河前无奖励；过河后按前进距离 + 中路加分
   420|      const crossed = pieceSide === 1 ? r <= 4 : r >= 5
   421|      if (!crossed) return 0
   422|      const adv = fwd * 20
   423|      const center = c >= 2 && c <= 6 ? 15 : 0
   424|      return adv + center
   425|    }
   426|    case P.ADVISOR: {
   427|      // 偏好九宫中心（红 r=8,c=4；黑 r=1,c=4）
   428|      const pr = pieceSide === 1 ? 8 : 1
   429|      return r === pr && c === 4 ? 15 : 0
   430|    }
   431|    default:
   432|      return 0
   433|  }
   434|}
   435|
   436|/**
   437| * 静态局面估值。正值 = 对 sideToMove 有利。
   438| */
   439|function evaluate(board, sideToMove) {
   440|  let score = 0
   441|  for (let r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
   442|    for (let c = 0; c < COLS; c++) {
   443|      const p = board[r][c]
   444|      if (p === 0) continue
   445|      const type = abs(p)
   446|      const pSide = side(p)
   447|      const val = PIECE_BASE_VALUE[type] + positionalBonus(type, r, c, pSide)
   448|      score += pSide === sideToMove ? val : -val
   449|    }
   450|  }
   451|  return score
   452|}
